title.purpose: Home product name and existing dialog emphasis; the base Regular face multiplied by 1.15 before UI scale.

body.purpose: Embedded base Regular face with the regional CJK chain; workspace titles use this normal size too. Measure with native ImGui metrics.

label.purpose: Same face and size as body; measure each label in the current language.

breakpoints.name: native-workspace-split
breakpoints.purpose: Unscaled available content width in draw_workspace_panels. Multiply by ui_scale(); below it use full-width tabs, otherwise scene left and properties right. This is not a CSS media query.

components.name: Ordinary Button
components.description: Explanatory scale-1 equivalent of the native control. Browser fonts, layout, and focus drawing may differ; the C++ implementation remains authoritative.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Explanatory scale-1 equivalent of the native control. Browser fonts, layout, and focus drawing may differ; the C++ implementation remains authoritative.

components.name: Selected Filter Button
components.description: Explanatory scale-1 equivalent of the native control. Browser fonts, layout, and focus drawing may differ; the C++ implementation remains authoritative. Selected remains a native button; there is no pill component.

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Explanatory scale-1 equivalent of the native control. Browser fonts, layout, and focus drawing may differ; the C++ implementation remains authoritative.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Explanatory native text-field palette, padding, and radius. InputText retains its field fill during hover and editing; browser editing does not reproduce native interaction.

components.name: Workspace Tabs
components.description: Explanatory native tab states, with a gray selected surface continuous with its editor. The static swatch does not implement tab switching or native keyboard handling; the optional overline is not shown.

components.name: Workspace Action Band
components.description: Explanatory bordered native child with persistent run controls. The real child measures its height and remains outside scrolling pages; this is not a runtime web card.

components.name: Command Row
components.description: Explanatory compact title button. Native command_row measures a wrapped title, retains the translated ID, and exposes the description on hover even when disabled. The browser title is only a tooltip equivalent.
components.html: <button class="ds-command" title="Open an already-processed dataset folder.">Open a Dataset...</button>

components.name: Shortcut Button
components.description: Explanatory inline-hint case with enough room. Native KeyButton measures fit, otherwise centers the label and exposes the key in hover help; this swatch does not implement the measurement.

components.name: Workspace Header
components.description: Explanatory compact native context strip at normal UI size. Native code measures Home, title, and context, wraps as needed, middle-elides long paths, and leaves navigation guards to callers; this short example does not reproduce that algorithm.

narrative.overview:
Spirula Studio uses Blender's neutral dark editor grammar within its native
Dear ImGui/GLFW application. Compact controls, narrow context headers, fine
boundaries, and a large scene area support repeated reconstruction work.
Blue identifies action and editable-value states; orange identifies focus
and manipulation feedback. The product retains its own task names, workflows,
and embedded Source Sans-derived face with regional CJK glyphs.

Context, execution, content, and diagnostics have distinct places. Shared
controls measure translated text; properties and previews own their scrolling
areas, while execution controls remain reachable. Wide scene workspaces put
properties on the right and apply their changes to the scene in the same
frame. Feedback is immediate native input feedback. This document records the
built system; task composition stays in the surface brief.
keyCharacteristics: Achromatic editor surfaces, dark fields, and fine tonal boundaries.
Neutral ordinary controls, blue action/value states, and orange focus cues.
One embedded Regular font chain with restrained size emphasis.
Measured wrapping, scaled geometry, and independently scrolling work areas.

rules.name: Meaning Before Accent
rules.body: Use action blue for action and value states, orange for the existing focus and manipulation roles, and neutral fills for ordinary controls.

rules.name: Measure the Language
rules.body: Measure rendered localized text with the current ImGui font and scale before placing controls, paths, or shortcut hints.

rules.name: Tonal Boundaries
rules.body: Separate shared surfaces with their existing fill and border roles; the shared theme has no cast-shadow layer.

dos: Do use ButtonStyle for Primary, Selected, and Danger roles with its scoped white foreground and native behavior.
Do scale handwritten geometry with px(), keep saved panel sizes unscaled, and rebuild style from its base before scaling.
Do measure localized labels, wrap complete controls with FlowRow, and retain full context in hover help when paths are elided.
Do keep execution controls outside scrolling pages and keep job polling and dialogs outside visibility-dependent callbacks.
Do evaluate properties before their scene preview even when the properties are placed on the right.
Do use the embedded regional font chain and preserve translated message IDs when customizing a control.
donts: Don't introduce an unimplemented display face, weight hierarchy, letter spacing, shadow, or decorative animation as a system rule.
Don't substitute the bright primary fill behind ordinary-text selected controls; preserve their darker native selection role.
Don't reserve shortcut space by guesswork or draw a hint over its label; use KeyButton's measured fit and tooltip fallback.
Don't treat saved panel width as rendered pixels or overwrite the preference merely because a smaller window clamps it.
Don't promote Home, Render, timeline, recent-category, or gizmo-specific composition and color into universal rules.
